The estimate uses your median spending on matching weekdays.
The model learns locally from weekdays, the day within your salary period, and previous spending.

Trying the personal model requires 120 consecutive covered days, 4 complete salary periods and 20 purchase days. It must then pass independent checks and beat the initial estimate; history alone does not activate it.
